description: Routes human intent to registered capabilities while keeping sensors, reasoning, policy, execution, and verification separate.

operating_model.interface: ChatGPT or the Veridan desktop interface receives natural-language requests.
operating_model.router: A deterministic router resolves an intent to one registered capability and fails closed when it cannot.
operating_model.agents: Specialized agents may analyze or prepare work only through registered capabilities.
operating_model.mcps: MCP servers and local bridges expose bounded tools and report observed state.
operating_model.memory: Obsidian remains the source-backed knowledge and protocol layer; Veridan Core remains the command center.
operating_model.automation: Events may propose work, but policy and approval gates remain authoritative.
operating_model.verification: No action is reported complete until its declared verification checks pass.

laws: Sensors report facts; AI interprets them.
Never infer machine state when it can be queried.
Never claim an action succeeded without verification.
Trading calculations come from TEKRAM, not the language model.
Live financial execution is isolated from reasoning and disabled in this baseline.
Screen and camera monitoring must be visible whenever active.
Sensitive sensor information is ephemeral unless explicitly saved.
